{{Short description|Distribution introduced by Gunnar Benktander}}
{{Probability distribution |
  name       =Benktander type II distribution| 
  type       =density|
  pdf_image  = [[Image:Benktander2PDF.svg|325px]]|
  cdf_image  = [[Image:Benktander2CDF.svg|325px]]|
  parameters =<math>a>0</math> ([[real number|real]])<br/><math>0<b\leq1</math> ([[real number|real]]) |
  support    =<math>x \geq 1</math>|
  pdf        =<math> e^{\frac{a}{b}(1 - x^b)}x^{b-2}\left(ax^b - b + 1\right) </math> |
  cdf        =<math> 1 - x^{b-1}e^{\frac{a}{b}(1 - x^b)} </math>|
  mean       =<math>1+\frac{1}{a}</math>|
  median     =<math>\begin{cases}
              \frac{\log(2)}{a}+1 & \text{if}\ b=1    \\
              \left( \left(\frac{1-b}{a}\right)\mathbf{W}\left(\frac{ 2^{\frac{b}{1-b}} a e^{\frac{a}{1-b}} }{1-b} \right) \right)^{\tfrac{1}{b}} & \text{otherwise}\ \end{cases}</math><br>Where <math>\mathbf{W}(x)</math> is the [[Lambert W function]]<ref group = "note" name = "WA">From [[Wolfram Alpha]]</ref> |
  mode       = <math> 1 </math>  |
  variance   =<math> \frac{-b + 2ae^{\frac{a}{b}}\mathbf{E}_{1-\frac{1}{b}}\left(\frac{a}{b}\right)}{a^2 b}</math><br />Where <math>\mathbf{E}_n(x)</math> is the generalized [[Exponential integral]]<ref group = "note" name = "WA" /> |

The '''Benktander type II distribution''', also called the Benktander distribution of the second kind, is one of two distributions introduced by Gunnar {{harvs|last1=Benktander|year=1970|txt}} to model heavy-tailed losses commonly found in non-life/casualty [[actuarial science]], using various forms of mean excess functions {{harv|Benktander|Segerdahl|1960}}. This distribution is "close" to the [[Weibull distribution]] {{harv|Kleiber|Kotz|2003}}.
